sonnet.problem: Jeremiah 9:10 is a statement of intent: 'I will take up a weeping and wailing…'. The card retells it as something already happening ('a weeping and wailing goes up'). Card 12 repeats this with 'Why is there wailing…'. The text's future tense is turned into a present event, and the 'I' speaker is dropped.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added. A prediction stays a prediction: "God says Tyre will fall," never "Tyre falls."
